name: Top Hat
looks: A tall flat-topped cylinder on a narrow brim, with a band just above the brim.

name: Cowboy Hat
looks: A pinched crown on a wide brim that curls up at both ends, with a band around the crown.

name: Propeller Beanie
looks: A round dome cap with a stripe across it and a little two-blade propeller on a stalk on top.

name: Pirate Tricorn
looks: A three-cornered hat, wide and low with a point at each end, edged with a trim along the top.

name: Viking Helmet
looks: A round metal dome with a band at its base and a curved horn sticking out and up on each side.

name: Chef's Toque
looks: A tall puffy hat that mushrooms out at the top, on a straight band around the head.

name: Royal Crown
looks: A crown with five points on a solid band, with round jewels set along the band.

name: Backwards Ball Cap
looks: A rounded cap worn backwards, its flat brim sticking out behind the head.

name: Party Hat
looks: A tall narrow cone with diagonal stripes and a pom-pom on the tip.

name: Traffic Cone
looks: A traffic cone worn as a hat, a square base at the bottom and a reflective stripe around the middle.

name: Upside-Down Bucket
looks: A tin bucket worn upside down, wider at the bottom, with a ridge band and the handle hanging off one side.

name: Toilet Plunger
looks: A rubber plunger cup stuck on top of the head with its wooden handle pointing straight up.

name: Hard Hat
looks: A construction hard hat: a smooth dome with a short brim all round and a raised ridge down the middle.

name: Firefighter Helmet
looks: A domed helmet with a long brim sweeping down at the back and a tall shield badge standing up at the front.

name: Wizard Hat
looks: A tall cone that bends and flops backward near the tip, on a wide floppy brim, with a band.

name: Jack-o'-Lantern
looks: A carved pumpkin worn as a hat, ribbed, with triangle eyes and a jagged grin cut into the front and a stem on top.

name: Birthday Cake
looks: A round layer cake on the head, frosting dripping down the sides, three candles on top.

name: Shark Fin
looks: A tall curved shark fin standing up from a band around the head.

name: Rubber Duck
looks: A big rubber bath duck sitting on top of the head, facing forward, with its round beak sticking out.

name: Soft Serve Swirl
looks: A tall three-tier swirl of soft serve with a curl at the top, sitting in a short wafer cup.

name: Knit Beanie
looks: A snug knit beanie with a folded cuff at the bottom and a big pom-pom on top.

name: Trapper Hat
looks: A round hat with a thick fur rim and fur ear flaps hanging down at both sides.

name: Devil Horns
looks: A thin headband with two short pointed horns curving up from it.

name: Captain's Hat
looks: A ship captain's cap: a flat wide top, a short shiny visor at the front, and a badge on the front.

name: Party Lampshade
looks: A lampshade worn at the end of a long party, wider at the bottom, with a fringe hanging from its lower edge.

name: Briefs on the Head
looks: A pair of briefs pulled on as a hat, the waistband around the head and the leg holes sticking up like ears.

name: Graduation Cap
looks: A mortarboard: a skullcap under a flat square board, with a tassel hanging off one corner.

name: Jester Hat
looks: A jester's cap with three floppy points drooping out to the sides and up, a bell on the end of each.

name: Hot Dog
looks: A hot dog lying across the top of the head, a long bun with the sausage poking out each end and a mustard zigzag.

name: Cheeseburger
looks: A stacked cheeseburger on the head: domed top bun, cheese drooping over a patty, flat bottom bun.

name: Round Wire Glasses
looks: Small perfectly round lenses in thin gold wire frames, pale blue glass.

name: Heart Shades
looks: Heart-shaped red lenses in thin red frames joined by a short bridge.

name: 3D Glasses
looks: Old cinema 3D glasses: a white frame with one red lens and one blue lens.

name: Ski Goggles
looks: One wide wraparound orange mirrored lens across both eyes in a thick black frame.

name: Taped Nerd Glasses
looks: Thick square black frames with a wad of white tape wrapped around the bridge.

name: Cat-Eye Glasses
looks: Pink frames with pointed outer top corners that flick up, dark lenses.

name: Swim Goggles
looks: Two small oval blue goggle lenses with thick rims and a strap stub at each side.

name: Steampunk Goggles
looks: Two round brass-rimmed goggle lenses, green glass, with a thick brass bridge.

name: Shutter Shades
looks: Party shades with horizontal slats instead of lenses, neon green frames.

name: Star Shades
looks: Five-pointed star lenses in gold, joined by a short bridge.
